tile_records.adql:
SELECT TOP 10 source_id,
       ra,
       dec,
       ref_epoch,
       pmra,
       pmdec,
       phot_g_mean_mag,
       phot_g_mean_flux,
       phot_g_mean_flux_error,
       phot_g_mean_flux_over_error,
       phot_bp_mean_mag,
       phot_rp_mean_mag,
       phot_bp_rp_excess_factor,
       parallax,
       parallax_error,
       ruwe,
       duplicated_source,
       visibility_periods_used,
       phot_variable_flag,
       distance_gspphot,
       distance_gspphot_lower,
       distance_gspphot_upper,
       ag_gspphot,
       ag_gspphot_lower,
       ag_gspphot_upper,
       ebpminrp_gspphot
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(
  POINT('ICRS', ra, dec),
  CIRCLE('ICRS', 45.5, -12.25, 0.1)
)

magnitude_error_source: local first-order approximation from phot_g_mean_flux_error; Gaia does not publish a symmetric phot_g_mean_mag_error column
